nodes.name: api
triggers: behind a load balancer (target group api; internet-facing or internal needs the ELBv2 collector)

evidence.source: ecs:DescribeTaskDefinition api:1 container app secrets DB_PASSWORD
evidence.detail: secret DB_PASSWORD holds the master secret of rds/legacy-db

evidence.source: ecs:DescribeTaskDefinition worker:1 container app env ANALYTICS_HOST
evidence.detail: ANALYTICS_HOST connects to rds/cluster/orders-db (its custom endpoint)

evidence.source: ecs:DescribeTaskDefinition worker:1 container app env MEMBER_HOST
evidence.detail: MEMBER_HOST connects to rds/cluster/orders-db (its member orders-db-2)

evidence.source: ecs:DescribeTaskDefinition worker:1 container app env LEGACY_ARN
evidence.detail: LEGACY_ARN holds the ARN of rds/legacy-db
DB_HOST connects to rds/cluster/orders-db (its reader endpoint)
DB_SECRET_ARN holds the master secret of rds/cluster/orders-db
role api-fn-role: Allow rds-data:ExecuteStatement on arn:aws:rds:us-east-1:123456789012:cluster:orders-db (inline policy data)
role report-role: Allow secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789012:secret:rds!db-0bbbb-GhIjKl (inline policy secrets)

findings.detail: DATABASE_URL names an endpoint called orders-db, like rds/cluster/orders-db in this scan, with another account's suffix: a namesake, not this database
EU_DB names an RDS endpoint in region eu-west-1, outside this scan
PROXY_HOST names an RDS Proxy endpoint; resolving it needs rds:DescribeDBProxies, which is not collected
role report-role may use every secretsmanager resource (secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on *, inline policy secrets): a grant this wide links to nothing in particular, so it draws no edge
